body:
The 174Hz Frequency Bracelet is the first wearable tool crafted to hold and broadcast the foundational healing energy of 174Hz—a frequency linked to pain relief, emotional release, and nervous system repair.

174Hz is the starting point of healing in the modern Solfeggio scale. When this frequency is in your field, your body receives a signal of safety. Your subconscious tension begins to soften. And the pressure you’ve been silently carrying? It starts to lift.

This bracelet allows you to maintain that frequency even when your generator is off. It’s designed for those working through stress, trauma, or chronic emotional and energetic heaviness—and want real, lasting support.

Benefits of Wearing This Frequency:

  • Supports pain relief and muscular relaxation

  • Restores coherence to the energy field and physical body

  • Helps the body exit fight-or-flight and enter healing mode

  • Anchors your energy into a grounded, safe, and supported state

  • Clears survival-mode programming and deep-rooted stress

The Formula:

  • Peach Moonstone – Encourages emotional gentleness and nervous system calm

  • Black Sardonyx – Strengthens energetic structure and internal stability

  • Black Lava Beads – Grounds and absorbs stress, promoting energetic discharge

  • Solid Copper – Enhances flow, conductivity, and mineral balance

  • Black Tourmaline with Red Iron Inclusions – Shields and strengthens the root chakra, offering resilience and protection

Use this bracelet to restore your base. To unwind what’s been stuck. To remember what it feels like to feel safe again—in your body, your energy, and your life.

Pair it with your 174Hz Generator and charge it for 33 minutes before wear to lock in the healing field.
